mapper.select: SELECT original.event_id AS receipt_event_id, original.occurred_time, original.currency, original.team_version, original.amount, CASE WHEN original.event_key LIKE 'OA_INVOICE_RECEIPT:%' THEN 'INVOICE' ELSE 'CRM' END AS source, -COALESCE((SELECT SUM(refund.amount) FROM crm_deal_event refund WHERE refund.tenant_id = original.tenant_id AND refund.reversal_of_id = original.event_id), 0) AS refunded_amount, original.amount + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(refund.amount) FROM crm_deal_event refund WHERE refund.tenant_id = original.tenant_id AND refund.reversal_of_id = original.event_id), 0) AS remaining_amount FROM crm_deal_event original WHERE original.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND original.biz_type = 'RECEIVABLE' AND original.biz_id = #{id} AND original.event_type = 'RECEIPT' AND original.reversal_of_id IS NULL AND original.baseline_flag = 0 AND original.event_id = #{receiptEventId} ORDER BY original.occurred_time DESC, original.event_id DESC

SELECT approval_id FROM crm_approval WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND business_type = 'crm_refund' AND business_ref_type = 'CRM_RECEIVABLE' AND business_ref_id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY approval_id LIMIT 1
SELECT currency FROM oa_contract WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND contract_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT currency FROM oa_contract WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND contract_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 FOR SHARE
SELECT contract_id, tenant_id, customer_id, contract_no, owner_id, currency FROM oa_contract WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND contract_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 FOR SHARE
